props.title: Single White Female

sections.content: **Single White Female** (1992) crystallized urban paranoia and roommate horror into a defining 90s thriller. Director Barbet Schroeder tapped into genuine anxieties about identity theft and urban isolation years before social media made these fears universal. The film follows a similar psychological thriller template as **Fatal Attraction** (1987), but shifts the focus to female relationships and identity. Jennifer Jason Leigh's unhinged performance as Hedy created one of cinema's most memorable stalkers, while Bridget Fonda captured the vulnerability of a young professional whose life is systematically invaded.

sections.content: The early 90s marked a golden age for psychological thrillers centered on domestic invasion. **The Hand That Rocks the Cradle** (1992) and **Pacific Heights** (1990) tapped similar veins of horror - trusted outsiders infiltrating private spaces. What sets **Single White Female** apart is its exploration of female identity and mimicry. Hedy's transformation from needy roommate to identity thief predated our current conversations about digital identity theft and catfishing by decades.

The film's influence echoes through later psychological thrillers like **Black Swan** (2010) and **The Roommate** (2011). Its DNA is evident in films exploring toxic female friendships and identity absorption, from **Ingrid Goes West** (2017) to **Greta** (2018). The signature scene of Hedy copying Allie's haircut became an iconic moment in thriller cinema, referenced and parodied countless times. sections.content: **Single White Female** helped establish a subgenre of thrillers centered on female antagonists who don't just threaten violence but seek to usurp identity. This theme evolved through films like **The Talented Mr. Ripley** (1999) and **Notes on a Scandal** (2006), where obsession leads to identity appropriation. Modern entries like **Gone Girl** (2014) and **A Simple Favor** (2018) continue exploring themes of female identity, deception, and psychological manipulation.
